I read this as codebase review and bug analysis of uncommitted UI changes - inspect modified and untracked files, evaluate implementation correctness, listener leaks, state mutations, test assertions, and asset references.

<analysis>
**Literal Request**: Review the uncommitted working-tree changes of /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite in `ui/src` and `ui/package.json` plus the new test files (`TerminalPane.test.tsx`, `TerminalSplitView.pointerDrag.test.tsx`, `TerminalSplitView.tabDropFallback.test.tsx`, `workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx`), summarize features, evaluate correctness/bugs/leaks, evaluate test coverage rigor, and check for broken asset references like `rorca-icon.svg`.
**Actual Need**: A rigorous technical audit of the uncommitted UI changes (tab drag-and-drop, pane splitting, divider dragging, persistence, terminal listeners, and tests) with file:line evidence, severity ratings, bug classifications, and verification of test assertions.
**Success Looks Like**: Comprehensive report structured with per-feature breakdown, bug/risk/leak findings with exact file:line references, test rigor assessment (mock vacuity vs real assertions), asset reference check, and structured `<results>` block with absolute paths.
</analysis>

### 1. Feature-by-Feature Summary of the Uncommitted Layer | Feature | Primary Files | Implementation Summary | |---|---|---| | **Pointer-based Tab Drag & Edge Split** | `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx`
`/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx` | Implements pointer capture and window move/up listeners on tab headers (`handleTabPointerDown`) to support dragging tabs to all 4 pane edges (`left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom` at 20% boundary threshold). Bypasses HTML5 `DragEvent` restrictions in WebKit/Tauri while preserving drop preview overlays. | | **HTML5 Drag & Drop Fallback** | `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx` | Provides `handleDragOver` and `handleDrop` fallback accepting `application/x-orca-tab` and `text/plain` transfers when Tauri/WebKit strips custom MIME headers. | | **Pointer-based Pane Resize Divider** | `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx` (`PaneResizeDivider`) | Renders draggable horizontal/vertical dividers with pointer down/move/up tracking on parent container bounding rect, enforcing minimum pane size (80px) and clamped ratios (0.10 to 0.90). | | **Session & Workspace State Persistence** | `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts` | Serializes and restores workspace layout, worktrees, active tabs, pane trees, and per-leaf session IDs (`serializeWorkspaceState` / `deserializeWorkspaceState`). | | **Agent Title & Activity Classification Rework** | `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/agentTitle.ts`
`/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts` | Normalizes terminal titles by stripping OSC/ANSI sequences, matches 22+ known CLI agents, and classifies activity into `working`, `waiting`, or `done`. Ensures agent-name-only titles return `null` activity (Orca parity) to avoid stuck spinner indicators when idle. | | **Terminal Mounting & Deferred Sizing** | `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx`
`/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts` | Handles initial zero-dimension DOM mounts by observing container size via `ResizeObserver`, awaiting font loading (`document.fonts.ready`), and scheduling two-frame RAF passes for clean xterm `fitAddon.fit()` without layout clipping. | --- ### 2. Implementation Correctness & Bug Audit #### Finding 1: Architectural Mismatch between Tab-Group Splitting and In-Tab Pane Merging - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/layout.ts:220-264`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts:190-230`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx:95-175` - **Severity**: **Major** - **Classification**: **Bug** - **Details**: In `workspaceStore.ts` (`splitPane`), dragging a tab to split dispatches `{ type: "MOVE_TAB_TO_SPLIT", sourceTabId, targetTabId, ... }`. In `layout.ts`, `MOVE_TAB_TO_SPLIT` is implemented to split **tab groups** (`tabGroups` / `tabGroupLayout`), keeping both tabs in `state.tabs` in separate groups. However, `TerminalSplitView.tsx` only renders `activeTabLayout.root` of a single active tab and expects the dropped tab's pane tree to be merged into `layoutsByTabId[targetTab.id]` (using `splitLeafWithSubtree` in `paneTree.ts:49`). As a result, tab-to-pane drag in the split view does not merge the pane subtrees into the active tab layout, and `workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx`'s assertions fail against `layout.ts`. #### Finding 2: Duplicate Listener Registration and Stale Closures in `TerminalHostManager` - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts:150-168` - **Severity**: **Major** - **Classification**: **Bug / Listener Leak** - **Details**: During instance creation, `terminal.onBell` and `terminal.onTitleChange` are registered twice: 1. Once via delegated lookup (`instance = this.instances.get(session.id); instance.onBell()`). 2. A second time via direct closure (`terminal.onBell(() => onBell?.())`). The second registration closes over the initial callback references. When `TerminalPane` re-renders and updates `existing.onBell` via `getOrCreate`, the second listener remains bound to the initial stale closure, resulting in duplicate event callbacks and stale prop invocation. #### Finding 3: Output Stream Leak on Terminal Session Backend Switch - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts:212-225` - **Severity**: **Minor** - **Classification**: **Resource Leak** - **Details**: `updateSession(sessionId, session)` checks if `session.backendSessionId !== prevBackendId` and subscribes to `terminalEventBus.subscribeOutput`. However, it does not unsubscribe the previous subscription before adding the new one, leaving the old backend output subscription active in `terminalEventBus`. #### Finding 4: Unmanaged Lifecycle of Terminal Instances (`destroy` Never Called) - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts:233-242`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts:300-345` - **Severity**: **Major** - **Classification**: **Memory Leak** - **Details**: `terminalHostManager.destroy(sessionId)` cleans up `resizeObserver`, `disposables`, WebGL context (`disposeWebgl`), and xterm instance (`terminal.dispose()`). However, `destroy` is never called anywhere when closing a pane (`CLOSE_PANE`) or tab (`CLOSE_TAB`). Instances stay in `this.instances` indefinitely across the session. #### Finding 5: Window Listener Leak in `PaneResizeDivider` on Unmount - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx:443-463` - **Severity**: **Minor** - **Classification**: **Risk / Leak** - **Details**: `PaneResizeDivider.handlePointerDown` registers `pointermove`, `pointerup`, and `pointercancel` directly on `window`. If the component unmounts mid-drag (e.g. keyboard shortcut closing tab or pane), the window event listeners are never cleaned up, and `document.body.style.cursor` remains stuck on `col-resize` or `row-resize`. #### Finding 6: Fallback Schema Bug in Session Persistence Deserialization - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts:128-132` - **Severity**: **Minor** - **Classification**: **Bug** - **Details**: When deserializing tabs where `t.sessionIdsByLeafId` is undefined (legacy persistence schema), the fallback is: `sessionIdsByLeafId: t.sessionIdsByLeafId || { [t.id]: t.sessionId }` The key used is `t.id` (tab ID) rather than the leaf ID (`t.activeLeafId` or root `leafId`), causing pane lookup `tabLayout.sessionIdsByLeafId[leafId]` to return `undefined`. #### Finding 7: LocalStorage Schema and Key Drift - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:24`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/App.tsx:20-22`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalSettings.ts:29`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/notificationSettings.ts:12` - **Severity**: **Minor** - **Classification**: **Risk / Schema Drift** - **Details**: Storage keys use three inconsistent brand prefixes: - `Sidebar.tsx:24`: `ferryx.sidebar.collapsedProjects` - `App.tsx:20-22`: `rorca.projects`, `rorca.active-project`, `orca.sidebar.open` - `Sidebar.tsx:23`: `orca.sidebar.width` - `terminalSettings.ts:29`: `orca.terminal.settings` - `notificationSettings.ts:12`: `rorca:settings:notifications:v1` In `App.test.tsx:101`, tests mock `rorca.sidebar.collapsedProjects`, which diverges from `Sidebar.tsx`'s actual runtime key `ferryx.sidebar.collapsedProjects`. --- ### 3. Test Rigor Assessment (New Test Files) | Test File | Test Case | Assertions & Rigor Assessment | Vacuous or Meaningful? | |---|---|---|---| | `ui/src/components/TerminalPane.test.tsx` | `waits for a measurable mounted container and then fits the new terminal to the full pane` | Mocks container dimensions to 0×0, asserts `fit()` is not called, triggers `ResizeObserver` callback with 960×640, and asserts `fitAddon.fit()` is called with host styles (`position: absolute`, `inset: 0px`, `100%`). | **Meaningful**: Directly tests zero-size mount guard and deferred fitting. | | `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.pointerDrag.test.tsx` | `routes another tab to all four Orca edge zones without relying on HTML5 DragEvent` | Verifies `draggable="false"` on tab, fires `pointerDown` + `pointerMove` to (5,82), (195,82), (100,37), (100,127), checks `data-drop-edge` (`left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom`), and asserts `onSplitPane` called with correct `direction`, `position`, and `sourceTabId`. | **Meaningful**: Pins pointer drag math, 20% edge threshold calculations, and drop dispatch. | | `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.pointerDrag.test.tsx` | `allows the active tab itself to use the pointer split path when another terminal tab exists` | Simulates dragging the active tab to split edge when a secondary tab exists; asserts `onSplitPane` is invoked for active tab. | **Meaningful**: Verifies multi-tab self-split permission logic. | | `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tabDropFallback.test.tsx` | `accepts a tab drop when WebKit exposes only text/plain and preserves the requested edge` | Simulates `dragOver` and `drop` with WebKit-restricted `text/plain` DataTransfer object; asserts drop preview edge and `onSplitPane` callback. | **Meaningful**: Directly verifies fallback MIME parsing for WebKit. | | `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx` | `moves the dragged tab's entire pane subtree into the requested split without spawning or closing PTYs` | Asserts `tabs` array removes source tab, target layout root becomes split containing source subtree, preserves session IDs without calling `spawnTerminal` or `closeTerminal`. | **Meaningful Test / Unimplemented in Reducer**: The test asserts correct Orca behavior, but the underlying reducer in `layout.ts` operates on tab groups rather than in-tab subtree merging (Finding 1). | --- ### 4. Broken and Stale Asset References (`rorca-icon.svg`) - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/public/sw.js:7` - **Code**: `'/src/assets/rorca-icon.svg'` - **Severity**: **Blocker** - **Impact**: `rorca-icon.svg` was deleted and replaced by `ferryx-icon.svg`. The Service Worker `install` event calls `caches.open(...).then((cache) => cache.addAll(ASSETS_TO_CACHE))`. Because `rorca-icon.svg` does not exist, `cache.addAll` throws a 404 network failure, causing Service Worker installation to completely fail. - **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/public/manifest.webmanifest:12` - **Code**: `"src": "/src/assets/rorca-icon.svg"` - **Severity**: **Major** - **Impact**: PWA manifest icon references the non-existent asset, breaking icon display when installed as a PWA / standalone web app. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx - Implements pointer capture and drag-reorder / pointer split start logic. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx - Handles edge drop resolution, HTML5 drag fallback, and pointer divider dragging. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx - Mounts xterm instance with ResizeObserver-driven full-pane sizing. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts - Manages xterm instances, settings, resize observers, and output event bus subscriptions. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts - Workspace state serialization and deserialization. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/agentTitle.ts - Normalizes terminal titles and classifies agent activity. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/layout.ts - Layout reducer managing tabs, tab groups, and pane trees. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts - High-level workspace state, PTY lifecycle, and terminal action handlers. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/public/sw.js - Service worker caching broken reference to deleted rorca-icon.svg. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/public/manifest.webmanifest - PWA manifest referencing deleted rorca-icon.svg. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalPane.test.tsx - Unit test for TerminalPane mounted sizing. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.pointerDrag.test.tsx - Unit tests for pointer tab drag and edge drop zones. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tabDropFallback.test.tsx - Unit tests for WebKit text/plain drop fallback. - /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx - Unit tests for tab-to-pane subtree split behavior. The uncommitted layer adds pointer-based tab dragging and splitting, HTML5 WebKit drop fallbacks, pointer divider resizing, session state persistence, and updated agent title activity classification. Key issues found: 1. **Deleted Asset References (Blocker)**: `ui/public/sw.js:7` and `ui/public/manifest.webmanifest:12` still reference `/src/assets/rorca-icon.svg`, which fails SW installation on 404. Update to `/src/assets/ferryx-icon.svg`. 2. **Tab-to-Pane Split Mismatch (Major)**: `workspaceStore.ts`'s `splitPane` routes tab drops to `MOVE_TAB_TO_SPLIT` in `layout.ts`, which manipulates `tabGroups` rather than merging pane subtrees with `splitLeafWithSubtree` into `layoutsByTabId`. 3. **TerminalHostManager Listener & Instance Leaks (Major)**: Duplicate `onBell`/`onTitleChange` event subscriptions with stale closures in `createInstance`, unmanaged backend switch output subscriptions in `updateSession`, and `terminalHostManager.destroy` is never invoked upon tab/pane close. 4. **Divider Drag Leak (Minor)**: `PaneResizeDivider` attaches `window` listeners without an unmount cleanup effect or window blur handler. 5. **Storage Key Inconsistencies (Minor)**: Drift between `ferryx.*`, `rorca.*`, and `orca.*` storage key prefixes. 1. Fix `ui/public/sw.js` and `ui/public/manifest.webmanifest` to reference `ferryx-icon.svg`. 2. Unify `MOVE_TAB_TO_SPLIT` in `layout.ts` / `workspaceStore.ts` to merge pane trees via `splitLeafWithSubtree` when dropping a tab onto a pane. 3. Clean up duplicate listeners in `terminalHostManager.ts` and wire `terminalHostManager.destroy` into `closeTab` / `closePane`. 4. Add unmount cleanup for window listeners in `PaneResizeDivider`.
